proposal.summary: Authenticated users can achieve remote code execution in Open edX Platform Ironwood 2.5 by adding a Problem component with Custom Python evaluated code when CodeJail is not enforced, allowing arbitrary OS command execution.
proposal.cwe_quote:
<script type="python">
def test_add(expect,ans):
    import os
    os.system("thecommandyouwanttoexecute")

</script>

AV.quote: And click Submit, and you will execute commands in the machine

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm whether CodeJail enforcement is disabled and, if so, immediately restrict the ability to add Custom Python evaluated code to trusted administrators, apply available vendor patches or upgrade to a fixed release, and audit for abuse or unauthorized commands.

evidence_quotes.claim: Attack requires authentication and access to edx-studio
evidence_quotes.quote: This is an authenticated vulnerability, so you need to register an account, go to /edx-studio

evidence_quotes.claim: Attack vector: adding problem with custom python code
evidence_quotes.quote: Then Create New course > New section > New subsection > New unit > Add new component > Problem button > Advanced tab > Custom Python evaluated code
